quest.title: The Mirrors, the Maze, and the Tsar
quest.description: You discover a deep pit near the Frostmoon Enclave...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, looks like this way is blocked...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's so deep! Looks like there's an even bigger space down below!
...Hey! You two, are you trying to get yourselves killed?
Don't just stand there! Get over here and keep your voice down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaah! You scared Paimon! She didn't expect to find anyone else in a place like this... And w—why are you hiding?
...Shh! I told you to keep quiet, buddy!
But judging by your chubby looks... Hah, you wouldn't happen to be the daughter of some Northland fae lord, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what do you mean by "chubby looks"!? Paimon's not chubby at all! And Paimon's not fae either!

choices.text: We're adventurers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's right. {M#He}{F#She}'s {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon, {M#his}{F#her} guide! We saw this deep pit and came here to investigate!
Yes, yes, of course. You're adventurers, definitely not nobility. We all need to wear some masks, am I right?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: But since you've all introduced yourselves, I should, for my part, do as decorum dictates. Maite Veliu, heir to the legendary thief Reed Miller. Don't worry, that's my real name.

choices.text: Whoa! A thief!

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: #I—I'm a master thief, not some petty crook, {M#brother}{F#sister}! Don't treat me like some cheap con artist! And I won't steal anything from you either!

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: *cough* Anyway... You're really a terrible liar, buddy.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Tell me, what kind of guide leads people straight into a deep pit?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—We did that because we're adventurers!

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Alright, alright. If I'm not mistaken, you're here for the <color=#00E1FFFF>Crab Tsar's treasure</color> too, aren't you?

choices.text: Treasure?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: #Oh? Trying to get me to spill the tea, huh? Heh heh, don't underestimate me, {M#brother}{F#sister}. I know how we fish for info.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: It's the most precious treasure hidden in the Crab Tsar's palace below... the st{RUBY#[D]Twardowska's Stone}one that can manipulate human desires. This is what I seek.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Oh, it just hit Paimon after hearing all this talk about thieves and some Crab Tsar — this must be some kind of children's adventure game, right?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... uh, how did you know that there's treasure here?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Hah, that's a master thief's secret, buddy. What's it gonna be? Interested in a team-up?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: I've already scouted out the palace routes and have a good idea where the treasure is. But I'm a master thief, not a mercenary. I can't defeat that despicable Crab Tsar all by myself.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: If I could, I wouldn't be hiding here, waiting for it to lower its guard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? If you're a master thief, why do you have to confront the palace owner head-on? Wouldn't that make you a robber instead?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: That shows you're an amateur, buddy. You can't get to the treasure without defeating the palace owner. Hidim— *cough* I mean, that's just how things work in the business.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Once we get that stone and sell it for a good price, we'll split it fifty-fifty, and I'll even hook you up with my informant. Interested?

choices.text: I still don't think stealing is right...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Um, even though she's being super cryptic about it, we're basically just looking for a stone in this cave, right?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (It might be dangerous to leave her alone down there. Best we follow her and keep an eye on her...)

choices.text: Alright, let's go and take a look.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Right, let's get to it then. Stay close and don't get lost.

choices.text: Your wish is my command, Miss Paimonovna.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What in the... Don't join her in talking nonsense, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: Leave it to me. I'm a world-famous thief after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As long as you add "world-famous" in front, then it doesn't matter what comes after, huh? Is that what you're thinking? No, we're just helpful adventurers, not thieves—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hmm? Wait... Come to think of it, our first major deed in Mondstadt was stealing the Holy Lyre der Himmel...)

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Ha! A world-famous thief... What are you going to say next? That you're a fugitive wanted in multiple nations?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Alright, alright, enough joking around. Even Reed Miller has never been wanted by every nation at once. Still, you're quite an interesting person, buddy.

choices.text: Hmph, perceptive little brats like you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You got into character so quickly! No, wait, don't say weird things like that all of a sudden! You sound like some annoying two-bit villain!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, so what's this treasure about again?

choices.text: I see, the Crabby Booty...

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: #Huh? What kind of nickname is that... Ahem. That's right! You know your stuff, {M#brother}{F#sister}. My target is the Crab... Crabby Booty.

choices.text: The legendary thief Reed Miller?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: It's alright if you're unfamiliar. Rest assured, I'm a master thief, not some small-time crook. Your belongings are safe where they sit in your pockets.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: However... You're a terrible liar, buddy.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Tell me, what kind of guide leads people straight into a deep pit?

choices.text: Miss Paimonovna. At this juncture, I advise that we feign—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Feign what? And who is Miss Paimonovna anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #In any case, {M#he}{F#she} is {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's {M#his}{F#her} guide! We're adventurers who've come to investigate this deep pit!

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: This way is blocked too, buddy. *sigh* If only we had abilities like those Frostmoon weirdos do...

talks.objective: Catch up to the Crab Tsar

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Looks like there's no way forward... Where did that big crab escape to?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is a problem. These mirrors were left behind by those Frostmoon weirdos. Only they and the Crab Tsar can travel through them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, so that big crab actually went inside the mirrors? It's just a crab, so where did it learn how to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: Well, it probably has something to do with that cursed st{RUBY#[D]Twardowska's Stone}one of desire.

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: *ahem* Better find a wall first, buddy, in case you fall over from what I'm about to tell you! I, Maite Veliu, am actually a member of the Conch Gang, here to gather intel—

choices.text: Oh, so you're also from the Conch Gang!

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Hm? What's with that reaction... Have you heard of us before?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Anyway, forget about that for now. Just so you know, I've been observing this place for quite some time already.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Truth is, His Majesty the Crab Tsar used to be quite docile, and it couldn't travel through these mirrors either — that is, until recently, when it found that stone from who-knows-where...

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: By which I mean that big stone you saw it carrying on its back. Since then, its temperament has taken a... particularly deadly turn.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Evil, cruel, easily agitated... Sometimes it even uses its pincers to crush other little crabs, turning this place upside down...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so the "treasure" you're looking for is actually the stone on its back! No wonder you say we'll have to defeat it first...

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Heh heh, that's right, buddy! According to the stories, Lovia, High Priestess of the Frost Moon, was also once bewitched by one such stone of desire five hundred years ago.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: The desperate pleas of Lady Aila moved the master thief Reed Miller to steal that cursed stone, and he captured her heart in the process — why else would she have remained unmarried for life?
...I see. Is this what you wish for, Ruler of "Elysium"?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Eeek!

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: *cough* No, I—I wasn't scared! I'm the heir of the legendary thief Reed Miller, I... Anyway, identify yourself, now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Y—You're that priestess who appeared near Thunderclap Reef earlier! Uh, Verna said you were a fake, though...

choices.text: Ruler of Elysium? Are you talking about Maite?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: #Ahaha, stop pulling my leg, {M#brother}{F#sister}! Do I look like a person of lordly caliber to you? That title suits you much better, don't you think?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: S—So what are you doing in a place like this, buddy? Eyes up — you're all alone, while there's three of us!

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: We are a fellowship of free people, and if you wish to seize us and take us to the Frost Moon, then you're outta luck! Even back when Snezhnograd had the legendary Reed Miller—
...Fear not, I am not your enemy.
Still, "Reed Miller"... is that the name you have chosen to follow in this sublunary sphere?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Hmph, o—of course! Anyway, I've got no interest in plots and schemes in the shadows. What exactly do you want? Out with it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and didn't you tell us to wait for you at the Court of the First Edict earlier?
...No, there's no need for such meaningless words. You are only here for the treasure... I know that. I've known it from the beginning...
...Cast your gaze that way. Look <color=#00E1FFFF>beneath the mirror</color>. When the <color=#00E1FFFF>mirror shatters</color>, you will find that cursed object that corrupts the hearts of men...
...As for me...

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Hey, wait, don't go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, she's gone again... Who in the world is that priestess?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: I—I don't know either. That one's acting all mysterious, just like Aila from the story... Those Frostmoon folks are always like this, never telling you the whole tale.

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: But I suppose there's no other choice now. Let's follow her advice and go look that way.

choices.text: Ruler of Elysium? Are you talking about Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Paimon!? Is Paimon a...? *ahem* Then Paimon, your Lady, commands you to go to Nasha Town and buy Paimon an endless supply of krumkakes... Um, just kidding.

choices.text: Ruler of Elysium? Are you talking about me?
Tch! Run, Miss Paimonovna! I'll hold them off!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Run? Wait, what's so scary about that!? Also, what kinda corny reaction is that? And who is Miss Paimonovna anyway?

response.speaker: Maite
response.text: Hah, it's normal to react that way when you hear our name. But don't worry buddy, I'm not your enemy.

talks.objective: Catch up to the Crab Tsar

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—It flew away...
...Have you come... searching for me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's the priestess from before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we weren't exactly looking for you, but... Who are you really?
It's always like this, always... Promising to take me away, then always leaving me behind...
This time is no different... Asking those questions just to give me false hope so I would stay, waiting for a salvation that will never come... isn't that right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, that's not what we meant! Please don't cry... We're adventurers, and we love helping others. If you need help with anything, just tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—It flew away...
...Have you come... searching for me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's the purple-haired priestess! She's appeared out of nowhere again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, you... could say we came to find you. You didn't reveal your identity earlier when Verna was here... Now it's just us, so you can say anything you want!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like, you could talk about the whole deal with this "Court of the First Edict"... You said you'd be waiting for us there, so how come you're here?
...Guiding the prophesied Ruler of "Elysium" is our mission in the sublunary sphere...
...I know who you are and what you want. I can see the threads of fate woven by moonlight, so... stop pursuing me. It is pointless...
It's always like this, always... Promising to take me away, then always leaving me behind...
This time is no different... Asking those questions just to give me false hope so I would stay, waiting for a salvation that will never come... isn't that right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: Alright, let's do this! Time to show that fellow what a proper, no holds barred frontal sneak attack looks like!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right! A frontal sneak atta— Wait, can you even call it a sneak attack if we do it from the front!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think she's a good person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, she talks weirdly and avoids our questions. She's got a real scary look on her face, too. Maybe she's the one who turned the crab into this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, wait... Where's Maite?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: Well, buddy, how's it going? Have you calmed down?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seems like it's hiding away out of regret, after all the terrible things it did to the little crabs while under the stone's influence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's kind of sad...

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: It's alright. Let it reflect on its actions for now. Those who do bad things must be punished — this is the fate of all evil rulers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon didn't expect that stone to fly away like that...

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: Well, it's not a bad thing. If it had actually circulated on the market, it might have hurt even more people.

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: Here, have this too. Now that His Majesty the Tsar has become docile once more, my observation notes are complete.

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: And from now on, you're a friend of the Conch Gang. When you dine at the Speranza Restaurant in Nasha Town, just mention the name Maite...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And I'll get my meal on the house?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: ...No, I don't have that kind of pull yet. You'll still need to settle your bills with Big Sis Katya.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's the point of mentioning your name, then!?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: O—Of course there's a point! If Big Sis Katya's in a good mood, she might even buy you all drinks or something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it still depends on someone else's mood!

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: *whimper* Th—Then, even if she isn't feeling up to it, I'll still buy you drinks... No, I'll treat you to a meal! I'll have to work a few days for the funds, though...

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: *cough* A promise is a promise, and one good turn deserves another — that's the rule set by the legendary Reed Miller! So take this IOU, buddy!

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: Hah! Nowhere left to run now, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: I know these grounds like the back of my hand, and I can tell you we've got it cornered. Once we take it down here, this will all be over.

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: #What do you say? Are you ready, {M#brother}{F#sister}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sh—She's gone again... Who in the world is that strange lady?

dialogues.text: I don't think she's a bad person.

dialogues.text: Yeah, even though she talks weirdly and has a scary look on her face, she seems to be guiding us...

dialogues.text: *whimper* Th—Then, even if she isn't feeling up to it, I'll still buy you drinks... No, I'll treat you to a meal! I'll have to work a few days for the funds, though...

dialogues.text: *cough* A promise is a promise, and one good turn deserves another — that's the rule set by the legendary Reed Miller! So take this IOU, buddy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, I need a moment to prepare...

dialogues.speaker: Maite
dialogues.text: No problem, I'll keep an eye on it for you... But try to be quick, buddy.
